In his last two games (Army and Louisiana), Baker averaged 6.9 yards per attempt, against 10.3 in his two games before that.

contradicting: When UL Monroe has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): UL Monroe’s offense has allowed a sack on 6.5% of its dropbacks, and Louisiana Tech’s defense sacks the quarterback on 9.8% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).
